{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Confirm there are no QA orders in the dataset
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == '999999.99'):")
print(len(qa_orders))

# Since there are no QA orders, we can proceed with mean age calculation
# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
valid_ages = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age of customers (excluding -1): {mean_age}")"}
